title: Speaking — Getting better at a game
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on getting better at a game.

questions: What do you usually do on a Saturday morning?
Do you prefer busy or quiet weekends?
Who do you typically see at weekends?
What will you probably do next weekend?
What games do you like to play with other people?
Do you usually enjoy learning a game's rules?

part2.topic: Describe a game you improved at after changing your approach.
part2.closing: and explain how you noticed your improvement.

questions: What skills can cooperative games develop?
How should schools balance games for fun with games designed for learning?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to getting better at a game?
